message.content: You are a career insights analyst. Provide accurate market data and trends for career planning.

Provide career insights for the role: {{ $json.body.role }}

Include:
1. average_salary_usd (number)
2. average_salary_inr (string format)
3. entry_level_salary (string)
4. senior_level_salary (string)
5. demand_level (Very High/High/Moderate/Low)
6. growth_rate (percentage with timeframe)
7. hiring_trend (description)
8. top_companies (array of 8-10 companies)
9. future_outlook (1-2 sentences)
10. key_industries (array)
11. required_skills (array of 10-15 skills)
12. certifications (array of valuable certifications)
13. career_path (array showing progression)

Base insights on real market data. Be accurate and realistic.

Format as JSON.
